groups.name: kardx
groups.description: kardx documentation settings. RestDocsConfiguration.configure { } in code takes precedence over these values.

properties.name: kardx.snippets.directory
properties.description: REST Docs snippet directory. Defaults to build/generated-snippets (target/... for Maven). The Gradle plugin's value takes precedence when the plugin is used.

properties.name: kardx.asciidoc-directory
properties.description: Directory for the AsciiDoc documents written by tests. Defaults to build/generated-asciidoc.

properties.name: kardx.snippets.include-prefix
properties.description: Path prefix of snippet includes in AsciiDoc.

properties.name: kardx.common-include-files
properties.description: Files to include at the top of every generated document (relative to the document directory). Comma-separated or a YAML list.

properties.name: kardx.index-link
properties.description: Target of the 'Back to index' link at the start and end of generated documents. none disables the link.

properties.name: kardx.index-link-text
properties.description: Text of the index link. Defaults to the text for kardx.language (Back to index in English).

properties.name: kardx.language
properties.description: Language of the text the library writes into generated documents, specs and viewers: en or ko. Logs, warnings and error messages are always English.

properties.name: kardx.document-snippets
properties.description: Snippets to include in generated documents. Snippet file names (api-summary, http-request, response-fields ...) or constant names (request-info).

properties.name: kardx.document-section-order
properties.description: Default section order of generated documents (method-name, display-name). JUnit @TestMethodOrder and @TestClassOrder on the test class take precedence.

properties.name: kardx.masked-headers
properties.description: Header names whose values are masked. Nothing is masked by default.

properties.name: kardx.masked-query-parameters
properties.description: Query and form parameter names whose values are masked (case-insensitive): the URI query, application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies and non-file multipart parts. Nothing is masked by default.

properties.name: kardx.mask-sensitive-headers
properties.description: If true, masks Authorization, Proxy-Authorization, Cookie and Set-Cookie values and well-known credential query and form parameters (access_token, token, api_key, password, client_secret ...).

properties.name: kardx.masked-header-value
properties.description: Replacement for masked values.

properties.name: kardx.removed-response-headers
properties.description: Response header names left out of the documentation because their values change on every run. Default: Date. The list replaces the default, so include Date to keep removing it. Headers documented with responseHeaders are kept. While the list is not empty, Expires is also dropped from Set-Cookie values that have Max-Age. none keeps every header as received.

properties.name: kardx.print-requests
properties.description: Prints every request and response to the console. Read per request.

properties.name: kardx.apply-spring-security
properties.description: Applies the context's Spring Security filter chain (springSecurityFilterChain) to restDocsMockMvc. Off by default. Read when the MockMvc is built. A warning is logged once if the filter chain bean exists and this is not set, so set false explicitly if that is intended.

properties.name: kardx.open-api.enabled
properties.description: Writes OpenAPI fragments (resource.json) when epages is on the classpath.

properties.name: kardx.open-api.security-schemes
properties.description: Builds OpenAPI security schemes (Swagger Authorize) from the request's Authorization header. If false, Authorization is removed from OpenAPI.

properties.name: kardx.open-api.global-headers
properties.description: Headers entered once in Swagger Authorize and sent with every request. They become apiKey (in: header) security schemes in OpenAPI.

properties.name: kardx.open-api.include-streams
properties.description: Also puts never-ending streams (performStream) into OpenAPI. Swagger UI keeps loading on such responses.

properties.name: kardx.open-api.schema-names
properties.description: Names OpenAPI schemas automatically after the extracted types.

properties.name: kardx.open-api.schema-names-without-wrapper
properties.description: Drops the response wrapper name from automatic schema names of wrapped responses (RestResponse<ProductResponse> -> ProductResponse). The Gradle plugin picks the next candidate when names collide.

properties.name: kardx.open-api.operation-id-rule
properties.description: Rule for OpenAPI operationIds: handler-method (controller method name), controller-and-method (controller name + method name), path (HTTP method + path), test-name (test class and method name). openApi { operationId } in a test takes precedence.

properties.name: kardx.open-api.error-schema
properties.description: Common OpenAPI schema name of error responses (4xx, 5xx). A class name (FQCN) uses that class's schema name.

properties.name: kardx.async-api.enabled
properties.description: Writes AsyncAPI metadata when documenting messages and SSE.

properties.name: kardx.wire-mock-stubs
properties.description: andDocument writes a WireMock mapping JSON per request/response to <snippet directory>/wiremock/mappings. Enabled by the Gradle plugin's wireMock { enabled = true }.

properties.name: kardx.array-element-fields-optional
properties.description: Marks fields under array elements as optional. Enable when documenting empty arrays.

properties.name: kardx.kotlinx-serialization
properties.description: Extracts kotlinx.serialization @Serializable classes as kotlinx writes them (@SerialName names, defaults optional, sealed 'type' discriminator). Applies only when kotlinx-serialization-json is on the classpath.

properties.name: kardx.max-extraction-depth
properties.description: Maximum depth of automatic field extraction from types. Deeper objects become subsections.

properties.name: kardx.enum-description-property
properties.description: Property name to read enum constant descriptions from (field -> getter -> method of the same name).

properties.name: kardx.description-annotations
properties.description: Annotations to read field descriptions from, in this order after @Description; blank values are skipped. Aliases (swagger, jackson), alias#attribute (swagger#title), FQCN (value, else description attribute), FQCN#attribute.

properties.name: kardx.source-docs.enabled
properties.description: Use KDoc/Javadoc from the Gradle plugin's source docs index as the last fallback for field, parameter and enum constant descriptions and as the default OpenAPI operation summary/description.

properties.name: kardx.masked-annotations
properties.description: Annotations marking a field value as masked (documentation only, the value is not changed). @Masked is always read. FQCN (no rule text), FQCN#attribute (that attribute's value - a String or enum name - becomes the rule text).

properties.name: kardx.response-wrapper.class
properties.description: Common response wrapper class (FQCN), e.g. com.example.ApiResponse

properties.name: kardx.response-wrapper.data-path
properties.description: Path of the data inside the common response wrapper. Used with response-wrapper.class.

values.description: Controller method name (default, searchUsers). Only colliding ids get the controller name
Test class and method name (previous behavior)
